titles.romaji: Secret Mission: Sennyuu Sousakan wa Zettai ni Makenai!
titles.english: Secret Mission - Undercover Agents Never Back Down!
titles.native: しーくれっとみっしょん～潜入捜査官は絶対に負けない！～

description:
Riko Ikazuchi is an undercover agent who keeps her true identity hidden while infiltrating different crime scenes. She is posing as a newlywed with her junior colleague Noma in an apartment where a criminal organization is based.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Episode 1 received an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on September 8th, 2023. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
